order: Independent root review of source/schema/input closure/command descriptor before SDK compile
Root owns bounded outer Job then explicit source-compile approval
Actual compile with raw streams and launch count retained
Independent root approval of each bound native pass/partition
Two complete native passes: ordinary+async each
Genuine baseline compile then class binding then five-missing-member RED

guard.ownership: Original W12 guard, launch suspended, assign job before resume, track owned process/job HANDLEs, no broad process-name termination
guard.trace: Retain SDK host trace at INFO level 3; never verbosity 4 flood. No dependency on a build-observer output format.
guard.payload: Pin full Python payload closure, not only python.exe: scripts/imports, stdlib/extensions/DLLs/configuration and selected interpreter. Bind dotnet host/SDK/runtime/CoreLib/reference assemblies, runtimeconfig, compiler, source files, Java/JDK payload and resulting artifact before launch. Exact absolute commands/environment/cwd/output caps receive prelaunch review.
guard.failure: Reject stale/missing source/runtime/artifact bindings, malformed wire, unexpected/missing/duplicate keys, output overflow, bad exit, timeout, unresolved cleanup or launch failure. Retain full raw failure output without truncation; oversized streams are not treated as successful captures.

parents: Root must invoke only dedicated root-* entrypoints. The unchanged guard owns a Python parent for180s; all full payload/hash verification, admission and workload execution are within that actual absolute deadline. Direct inner invocation lacks mandatory bound outer context.
outerEnvironment: Descriptor outerEnvironment is passed as env to guard.run, never a parser field.
counters: on_update records launched before exit validation. Failed actual child=1; deferred/no-child=0. Root aggregate updates on launch too.
freeze: Root must freeze all authoring bytes and inspect report/lock before actual invocation. Once invoked, every producer input remains immutable; fixes require versioned successor and retained failures.
nativeHash: UNBOUND until actual successful compile; no source prediction is an artifact hash.
sdkPolicy: Direct pinned csc.dll over full reference inventory; no dotnet build/restore/NuGet/network/version process.
fullPayload: All 34 Python files + .NET SDK/runtime/host/references + complete JDK + licenses pinned by raw bytes before actual compile.
wire: Closed exact-case framing; all integer fields reject Boolean carriers; raw unexpected exceptions retained and fail closed.
parentBudgetAdmission: Root context uses guard actual first clock sample+180. Child full SDK/JDK/Python inventories+bytes reverified inside that parent and recorded in payload-admission.json. Fresh resource sample follows; reserve full workload ceiling+cleanup5 against actual outer deadline immediately before launch. Otherwise DEFERRED_NO_CHILD. Interrupted parent without finalized no-child evidence reports inner count UNKNOWN.
proofConsumption: Compilation binding, baseline binding and native verification consume root receipt plus separately pinned inner receipt, raw streams, outer context and full-payload admission proof. Inner receipt alone is insufficient.
